changelog: Turn YouTube lesson captions into a 4 to 8 knowledge-point still set.

en.description: Turn YouTube lesson captions into a 4 to 8 knowledge-point still set. This caption to knowledge-point studio reads public lesson captions, then lays out knowledge-point stills as a lesson card pack. Use it for lesson point cards and YouTube lesson caption cards.
en.summary: Turn YouTube lesson captions into a 4 to 8 knowledge-point still set.
en.title: YouTube Lesson Caption Cards: Caption to Knowledge-Point Stills
